department: Department of Computer Science (Washkewicz College of Engineering)

deadline.value: The general fall deadline is July 21; some programs set earlier dates, and this page gives none.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is required of all engineering doctoral applicants, with 80th-percentile quantitative scores usually expected.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General section is required of all applicants. | Minimum scores at the 80th percentile on the Quantitative section and 3.5 on the Analytical Writing section are usually required depending on the specialization area.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission comes first; an interim advisor is assigned afterward.
supervisor.quote: When a student is admitted, an interim advisor is assigned in his/her specialization to assist the student in completing a preliminary study plan.

funding.value: Research assistantships are provided through sponsored research activities depending on college funding availability.
funding.quote: Research assistantships are provided through sponsored research activities; the number available at a given time is dependent on the research activity within the College.

entry_route.value: The degree is 60 credits beyond a master's, so applicants usually hold one.
entry_route.quote: The degree requires a minimum of 60 credit hours beyond a master’s degree

toefl_min.value: Engineering requires a 78 iBT with at least 20 reading, 21 listening, 17 writing and 20 speaking.
toefl_min.quote: Note: The College of Engineering has higher TOEFL (iBT) subscore requirements: 78 (Reading: 20, Listening: 21, Writing: 17, Speaking: 20)

notes: Joint specialization with the Cleveland Clinic. Degree is 60 credits beyond a master's and 30 of dissertation work.
name: PhD in Engineering - Applied Data Science
